notes: The Spanish prompt gates every one of its twenty floors behind punching a giant floating hand until it dies, so the loop is melee boss combat and Action leads, with Obby & Platformer named second for the hazard floor of lava, spikes and platforms that vanish every three seconds. Shape is rooms-sequence, which Action words as an arena chain and its genre note pairs with arena-lockin as exactly this door-stays-shut-until-the-fight-is-won pattern; I rejected course-tower because the floors are sealed combat rooms rather than a jump course, and interior-single because that is one enclosed space rather than twenty. The room's traps and vanishing platforms ride on spawner-npc, which covers trap emitters as well as hostiles, and the per-floor restart point is spawn-protected, set back from the aura in the room centre — both keep the picks in the leading genre's vocabulary, where Obby's timed-platform and checkpoint rows are not available; I also dropped the preset's destructible-cluster since nothing in the room is breakable. Decided without asking: the route stays P0 because each floor is a discrete enclosed room in the chain, so nothing overhangs anything inside a generated space and Obby's genre-wide P6 does not follow it into a mix it does not lead; floors are a small 40x40 chamber each per the author's answer; and the every-fifth-floor difficulty ramp, the automatic restart to floor one after floor twenty, and the health bar, floor counter and mobile attack button are stat, script and UI work with no layout expression.
